name: Insightful
summary: A work intelligence platform: workforce analytics plus AI process capture — time tracking, how work actually flows, and insider-threat detection as a paid add-on, priced per seat.
best_for: COOs, CFOs and operations leaders who want a work intelligence platform rather than a time clock: workforce analytics plus AI process capture — where the hours go, and how the work actually flows — across in-office and remote teams
skip_if: you value a low-surveillance culture, run a tiny team, or need a monthly price you can compare up front — month-to-month billing exists on select plans, but every rate on the pricing page is the annual one
honest_knock: This is employee-monitoring software, so weigh the culture cost, not just the price: the advertised $8-16 rates are per seat AND are the annual ones (month-to-month exists on select plans but is never priced), security features like insider-threat detection are a paid add-on, and monitoring tools can damage trust if rolled out without transparency.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per seat a month, billed annually
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-09 against the vendor's own pricing page, re-read unchanged 2026-09-26) (2026) Per seat; the rates below are the annual ones. Workforce Analytics $8/seat/mo, Workflow Optimization $12/seat/mo (a beta open to selected customers), or both bundled at $16/seat/mo (saves 20%); Enterprise custom, and that is where audit logs and SSO sit. Add-ons: Workspace Security $4/seat/mo, screen recording $4, on-demand screenshots $4, higher-frequency screenshots $3 (up to 120 an hour), data-warehouse integration $0.50 for the whole bundle of custom API access, BigQuery and Snowflake. The page adds one line under the plan cards: month-to-month billing is available on select plans, without naming a monthly rate. A 7-day free trial gives full access except Automatic Time Mapping, no card. Admin, manager and client users are not billed unless you also track them, and users added mid-cycle are prorated. On-premise deployment requires at least 250 licences. New on the page since the last reading: a '7-Day ROI Promise', a conditional offer whose only remedy is a 30-day service credit.

compare_with.name: Time Doctor
compare_with.why: The set buyers actually weigh this against is ActivTrak, Teramind, Hubstaff and Time Doctor — workforce-analytics tools, not shift-scheduling apps. Time Doctor is the established time-tracking incumbent; Insightful leans into workforce analytics and workflow optimization on a similar per-seat model, so decide on features and how much monitoring your culture can carry. Of that set we have reviewed Hubstaff so far.
